400.title: Bad Request
400.message: The request could not be understood by the server. Please check your input and try again.
400.tip: Make sure all required fields are filled correctly and the format is valid.

401.title: Unauthorized
401.message: You need to be authenticated to access this resource. Please log in first.
401.tip: If you don't have an account, you can create one on the registration page.

403.title: Forbidden
403.message: You don't have permission to access this resource.
403.tip: If you believe you should have access, please contact the administrator.

404.title: Page Not Found
404.message: The page you are looking for might have been removed, had its name changed, or is temporarily unavailable.
404.tip: Check the URL for typos or try navigating back to the homepage.

500.title: Internal Server Error
500.message: Something went wrong on our servers. Our team has been notified and is looking into it.
500.tip: Please try reloading the page in a few moments, or contact support if the issue persists.

503.title: Service Unavailable
503.message: The server is temporarily unable to handle the request due to maintenance or capacity overload.
503.tip: We'll be back online shortly. Thank you for your patience.

default.title: Unexpected Error
default.message: An error occurred while processing your request.
default.tip: Please return to safety or try your request again later.
